docs.title: Autonomous Indoor Drone Exploration
docs.text: Welcome to the documentation of Group 2 for the Master Project "Drones with Artificial Intelligence" (Winter Semester 2026/27) at the Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences, supervised by Prof. Dr. Christian Baun.

docs.title: About the Project
docs.text:
The primary goal of this project is to develop, implement, and evaluate a drone-based solution for the automatic exploration and mapping of indoor environments.

Since reliable GPS signals are unavailable inside buildings, traditional drone navigation fails. To solve this, our drone relies on a combination of alternative localization methods, including Optical Flow, LiDAR distance measurements(, and visual odometry). The system must safely navigate unknown corridors, avoid obstacles and create a 2D/3d occupancy map.

!!! tip "The Challenge" A major challenge of this project is the limited hardware capacity on board (Raspberry Pi Zero 2 with only 512 MB RAM). Therefore, we implemented a 3-layer architecture: Real-time flight control is handled on the drone, while heavy computations like ROS 2 SLAM and path planning are offloaded to a Ground Control Station via a MAVLink Wi-Fi bridge (Raspberry Pi Zero 2).
